title: Short pants and long pants for young musicians
summary: Boys wore short pants until about sixteen to eighteen; Happy had learned his instrument before going out.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, how old did you have to be before you put on long bands in those days?

Well, those old days, old days, they used to un-boy them all. They'd be great to go by the short band. Mm-hmm. They'd keep on them. They'd tell them that because they're in the event, they'd put them in there. Would you get to say when you were eighteen, would you wear a short band? Well, we would be a big band, or then seventeen, sixteen, sometime eighteen.
But you had a pretty good age on you then, before you started playing music. I mean, you'd been playing it a while. I had been playing it. Before you went out professionally.
Before I went out, you see, you see, when I went out, I'd hold my instrument.
See? I know the instrument. I know it all about the instrument, David and the instrument. I know that. I know it's a key time and everything.
